message: @unique on field "User.email" has the same fields, with the same sort, as another index of the model. Prisma 6 refuses this: "Index already exists in the model." Remove one of them.
@@unique on model "User" has the same fields, with the same sort, as another index of the model. Prisma 6 refuses this: "Index already exists in the model." Remove one of them.

Model "User" has two indexes on the same fields that differ only in whether they write sort: Asc, which is the default sort. MongoDB holds them as one index, so the database cannot have both. Remove one of them.
